freeIndicators.name: Swing Flow Indicator
freeIndicators.description: Trend-following tool using pivot points to identify price direction and momentum. Plots midline with dynamic upper/lower bands and detects sideways markets.

freeIndicators.description: Estimates how long bullish/bearish trends will persist using Hull Moving Average. Tracks historical durations and projects continuation forecast with real-time updates.

freeIndicators.name: Zone Shift
freeIndicators.description: Dynamic trend detection using EMA/HMA-based bands. Identifies trend shifts, recolors candles (lime/blue), plots trend initiation levels, and marks retest diamonds with noise filtering.

freeIndicators.name: Trend Levels
freeIndicators.description: Identifies key trend levels (High/Mid/Low) during market trends. Measures trend strength via candle positioning relative to midline with percentage-based readings.

freeIndicators.name: Trend Classifier
freeIndicators.description: Multi-level trend classification with 3 bullish and 3 bearish strength levels. Color-coded candles (aqua/red/orange), diamond markers for changes, and real-time strength dashboard.

freeIndicators.name: Market Shift Levels
freeIndicators.description: Identifies trend reversals using Hull Moving Average crossovers. Plots horizontal levels at swing points where momentum shifts occur, with volume labels on retests.

freeIndicators.name: Market Structure Trend Targets
freeIndicators.description: Tracks trend direction by marking significant price breaks. Sequential numbering shows continuation, dynamic stop loss levels, and mean reversion diamonds.

freeIndicators.name: Specter Trend Cloud
freeIndicators.description: Visualizes trend via colored cloud overlay (aqua=bullish, orange=bearish). Uses dual MA comparison with ATR adjustment. Diamond markers and dotted retest levels.

freeIndicators.name: Pivot Trend
freeIndicators.description: Trend reversal identification using pivot point analysis. Blue lines for uptrends, red for downtrends, with B/S buy/sell signals.

freeIndicators.name: Future Trend Channel
freeIndicators.description: Dynamic indicator identifying trends and projecting future price levels using SMA and ATR-based channel formations. Green=uptrend, orange=downtrend, with forward projection.

freeIndicators.name: High-Low Cloud Trend
freeIndicators.description: Combines trend following and mean reversion in a dynamic cloud representation. Primary bands for main trend, secondary for mean reversion detection.
